title: Synthetic talk: Shipping typed AI agents
speaker: Sample Speaker

chapters.title: Intro
chapters.notes: The speaker explains why unvalidated LLM output breaks production systems.

chapters.title: Defining output types
chapters.notes: Shows a Pydantic model with a field validator and passes it as an agent's output type.

chapters.title: Retries
chapters.notes: Demonstrates the agent sending a validation error back to the model, which fixes its answer.

chapters.title: Testing
chapters.notes: Replaces the real model with a fake one in pytest so tests run offline.
